payload.text: WP-01 adds no third-party cost to prez. The comrak dependency line is byte-identical across WP-01, and prez's COMPILED closure -- `cargo tree -p prez --edges normal,build` -- carries the same 17 third-party packages before WP-01 and at HEAD. THE INSTRUMENT IS PREZ'S CLOSURE AND NOT THE WORKSPACE LOCKFILE, which is a correction rather than a preference: the lockfile answered for prez only while prez was the workspace's only package, and even then it counted 7 packages nothing compiles. The one addition is `artifact` -- first-party, path, std-only, taking no dependencies of its own -- signed off by hv 2026-09-09 as a one-off.
